about: Who and what made this game, as the record shows it. Gathered 2026-11-10 from the repository's commits and their sign-offs, the saved build sessions, the code's own history, and the door's options file. A model is named with the version the record gives. Where the record gives none, the entry says so and names none: add the version here when it is known.

people.name: Pedro Garcia
people.did: The design, every ruling in the plan, and the playing. Every commit is under his name.

built.name: Gemini, in Google AI Studio
built.did: The first version: the project's frame, the ranks and rarities, the first item factory and the first world on a canvas.
built.record: The first commits, 2025-11-21, are an AI Studio export. Which Gemini wrote them is not on record.

built.name: Claude, on claude.ai
built.did: The first overhaul and its handover, then the design conversations the plan grew from.
built.record: Commit 9e98b65, 2025-11-22: "massive overhaul courtesy of claude!". The conversations are in Pedro's own archive. Which Claude each one was is not on record.

built.name: Claude Fable 5
built.did: The game's return after eleven months: the playable loop, the systems plan, and its first waves, from signed saves and the one grid to the interface, the houses, the load-out and the anatomy of items.

built.name: Claude Fable 5.1
built.did: A few turns inside those first two days of sessions.
built.record: Named 18 times in the saved build sessions of 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31. It signed no commit.

built.name: Claude Opus 5.5
built.did: Most of the game as it stands: the living worlds and their clock, the people and their memory, the two stores, the door to a model, the hub and the hosted world, and the passes that joined them.
built.record: 253 commits signed, 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-09, and most of the saved build sessions.

built.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
built.did: Searches and small errands inside a build session.
built.record: Named in the saved build sessions of 2026-11-01, as a helper. It signed no commit.

built.name: Claude Fable 5.2
built.did: The fixes before Pedro's own run, his three rulings of 2026-11-10, the game's own window, and this screen.
built.record: The commits of 2026-11-10 signed "Claude", and that day's build session.
